_comment: Synthetic NEGATIVE CONTROL for the inject-class twin (the deliberately weaker split claim, doc 20 §7.3): an inject-class STS session present in the VM by design — which is NOT a violation — but whose TTL bound is absent (ttl_seconds=0) AND whose ISSUED{service_id} digest is missing. The inject-class twin asserts the TTL bound + ISSUED digest, so this must FAIL with BOTH named classes inject-class-credential-ttl-unbounded and inject-class-credential-issued-digest-missing. In-VM presence itself is not flagged.
